title: A Contact for the Drop
premise: Felix Joubert, a whistle-blower living under four names, receives a meeting invitation from her dead handler, Marguerite, and realizes someone has cracked her network of identities. The invitation leads her into a trap set by the private intelligence firm she exposed a decade ago, now desperate to recover the one file that could collapse their Frankfurt-listed parent company before markets open. As Felix races through Brussels and Frankfurt with an idealistic young analyst who defects to help her, she must decide whether to trade the file for her own survival or detonate it and lose everything. In the end, she releases the file at dawn, sacrifices her fourth name, and escapes with the analyst into a life that is finally, dangerously real.
about_author: Silas Voss is the pen name of a former financial journalist who spent years covering corporate espionage in the EU before turning to fiction. He writes thrillers about people trapped between conscience and institution.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: POV: Felix. Living quietly as 'Claire Deverell' in Porto, Felix receives a calendar invite from Marguerite's email—sent two days after Marguerite's confirmed death, for a meeting tomorrow at 6 a.m. in Frankfurt. She verifies the death herself and feels ten years of careful invisibility begin to crack. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into resolve; the rules have changed and she knows it.

chapters.title: Four Names
chapters.summary: POV: Felix. On a night train north, Felix audits her own legend—passports, dead drops, the protocol Marguerite drilled into her—and finds each layer already compromised. A flash drive hidden in a Lisbon safe deposit box holds the file worth killing for. Emotional beat: claustrophobic paranoia giving way to cold competence as she decides to go on offense instead of running.

chapters.title: The Analyst
chapters.summary: POV: Tomas. Tomas Reiner, a junior compliance analyst at Meridian Capital in Frankfurt, is ordered to verify a client identity that matches Felix's second name. His discovery of falsified KYC records pulls him toward the firm's rot. Emotional beat: idealism curdling; he chooses curiosity over obedience, not yet understanding the cost.

chapters.title: Dead Handler's Hand
chapters.summary: POV: Felix. In Brussels, Felix traces the invitation's metadata to Marguerite's old safehouse and finds a posthumous letter: Marguerite knew she was dying, knew the firm was closing in, and set this meeting as both bait and inheritance. Emotional beat: grief braided with betrayal—her protector used her one last time, but left her the map to survive it.

chapters.title: The Buyer
chapters.summary: POV: Felix. At a pre-dawn rendezvous, Felix meets the supposed buyer—a Meridian fixer named Kessler—who offers her a new life in exchange for the file. She stalls, reading his tells, and realizes the meeting is a verification exercise: they're confirming which alias she'll surface under. Emotional beat: controlled terror; every word she speaks is data against her.

chapters.title: Defection
chapters.summary: POV: Tomas. Tomas confronts his director about the falsified records and is offered a promotion to stay silent. Instead he copies the internal trail linking Meridian to the surveillance operation hunting Felix, and walks out. Emotional beat: quiet courage hardening into commitment; love begins here, as duty and conscience split apart.

chapters.title: Interlock
chapters.summary: POV: Alternating. Felix and Tomas meet through a dead drop gone wrong, recognize each other as the only honest players left, and pool what they know: the file proves Meridian's parent company laundered the very whistle-blower program that created her. Emotional beat: wary alliance becoming trust—the first intimacy either has allowed in years.

chapters.title: The Long Night
chapters.summary: POV: Alternating. Hunted through Frankfurt's financial district overnight, the pair evades Kessler's teams while preparing dual contingencies: trade the file, or release it. Kessler captures Tomas briefly, then lets him go as bait. Emotional beat: rising desperation and tenderness under pressure; they confess what they're each willing to lose.

chapters.title: Before the Bell
chapters.summary: POV: Felix. In Meridian's tower as markets prepare to open, Felix faces Kessler and the CEO's proxy with the file in hand. Offered everything—money, a clean name, Marguerite's old position—she sees the corruption offer itself as proof of the thesis. Emotional beat: the climax; love against duty resolves as she chooses the truth over the trade, triggering the release at 9:00 a.m.

chapters.title: A Fifth Name
chapters.summary: POV: Felix. The file detonates across European markets; Meridian's parent collapses, Kessler vanishes, and Felix becomes unrecognizable even to herself. With Tomas, she builds a fifth identity—not to hide, but to live. Emotional beat: exhausted peace; inheritance reclaimed, power broken, and love chosen without permission from anyone.
